QuestInfo.name: Investigating the Suspicious Person
QuestInfo.0: Eels received a secret letter from the Dark Lord and is investigating the Dual Blades. Go see Eels immediately.
QuestInfo.1: Eels says that people with ulterior motives have entered Kerning City disguised as thieves. He says there's one person standing in front of the Jazz Bar who appears really suspicious, and he wants you to investigate his motives. \r\nYou wonder if he means #bRyden#k...
QuestInfo.2: Eels said that people with ulterior motives have entered Kerning City disguised as thieves. He said there was one person standing in front of the Jazz Bar who was really suspicious, and he wanted you to investigate his motives. \r\nRyden, the suspicious person standing in front of the Jazz Bar, was taken aback, but devised a plan to trick Eels.
QuestInfo.summary: The Thief Job Instructor is suspicious of #bRyden#k. Go see #bRyden#k in Kerning City.

0.0: What is it? I'm just a regular janitor.\r\n#L0##bI just stopped by, because I noticed you while I was traveling through Victoria Island. I heard a lot about you from the Dark Lord. He says that you've been very busy these days, and he was wondering if there is any way I can assist you.#l\n#k
0.1: The Dark Lord? So, you know about...\r\n#L0##bYes, I know about it. It's supposedly top secret, but it's not hard to figure out in light of recent incidents.#l\n#k
0.2: I can see that you are very bright. Very well, it's true. I think they are more deeply involved than we realize. I need to find out who they are and what their plans are. Do you think you could help me?

yes.0: There is no doubt they're already active inside Kerning City. They've been doing a good job trying to keep hidden, but they can't fool me. In fact, I've spotted someone who is very suspicious. You know that guy standing in front of the Jazz Bar, watching people all day long? It's him...
yes.1: Find out what he's hiding. You don't know who I'm talking about? It's the guy wearing the reed hat. From what I can gather, his name is #bRyden#k. I need you to find out what he's keeping secret.

no.0: If you spoke with the Dark Lord, then you'd know the importance of this mission.

1.0: So, what's the deal? Did you talk to him?\r\n#L0##bI think he has his eyes on you. He seems to feel that you are suspicious.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, really? I guess he's not as dumb as he looks. So, he told you to come find out about me? In that case, let's give him an answer.

npc.0: Find out what he's hiding. You don't know who I'm talking about? It's the guy wearing the reed hat. From what I can gather, his name is #bRyden#k. The look in his eyes tells me he's hiding something...
